messages.content: Sort out the perfect order of symbols. Depending on the order of all symbols is the system's performance. The system consists of a distinct set of four symbols (each present once). 1. A = yields best performance if not followed by more than one symbol 2. B = yields best performance if not preceeeded by symbol A or C 3. C = yields best performance unless it is the last symbol 4. D = yields best performance when being the first symbol
The perfect order of symbols for optimal system performance would be D-B-A-C. This arrangement ensures that each symbol is placed in its ideal position to maximize efficiency.
